Co-op starter, the jar labelled Old Mother, is fed at 07:00 and 19:00: 100 g
rye flour, 100 g water, discard down to 200 g. The feeding log hangs on the
walk-in door; initial each feed. If the starter smells of nail varnish it is
hungry, so feed it twice that day.
